evidence: Types match the ask in every dimension. Gates: render/judge.toml:20-35 and constraints/judge.toml:20-34 are single binary criteria with aggregation all_pass (pass/fail reachability). Functional: all 17 criteria in scored/functional/judge.toml (lines 33-243) are type=binary with explicit 'Fails if ...' conditions and positive controls; each is a correctness/security behavior (client scope, wall on every route, retention boundary at exactly 7 days, holds, stale edit refusal, XSS-safe formatting, idempotent send, persistence) where partial credit would be wrong, so binary fits. Graded signal comes from per-criterion weights 1.5-3.0 with weighted_mean, matching the workbook internal note (binary + weighted). Polish: 5 binary criteria (timer_label, hold_mark, phone_matter, transcript_print, refusal_in_place; polish/judge.toml:20-63) are presence/behavior checks (label near title, badge visible without hover, scrollWidth==viewport, no composer in transcript, refusal reason inline and persistent) - same binary convention as the template polish dimension. Visual: 4 craft criteria (matter_sidebar, retention_marks, transcript_page, phone_chambers; visual/judge.toml:20-82) are type=likert points=5 with a described anchor at every level 5,4,3,2,1,0, matching the template visual format; visual/prompt.md:28-36 makes the anchored 0-5 scale authoritative over RewardKit's generic 1-5 hint and :40-43 keeps criteria independent. No craft criterion is typed binary and no likert block lacks anchors (the SKILL.md:65 / quality-checks.md:170 failure modes). Counterexample attempts: (a) broken-but-pretty app - the visual likert cannot rescue it because every functional behavior is a binary with its own controls; (b) functional-but-plain app - gets graded 1-3 on visual anchors rather than 0, so likert preserves gradation; (c) conforming app failing on a type choice - closest case is polish transcript_print, whose binary uses the quality words 'clean, readable', but its operative test is the objective absence of composer/navigation controls, so a plain conforming transcript passes. Minor observations, not defects: likert 4-anchors are terse ('clear with one weak selection state', 'fits with one tight spot') but are described; phone_matter (polish binary) and phone_chambers (visual likert) overlap at 390x844, which belongs to the double-counting/weight rows, not this one. Scope: this is a static type/anchor-design review; no judge runs were performed or required for this row, and no Oracle/model/portal score is claimed.
